NYMPH_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_THOUGHT.title: Thought
NYMPH_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_THOUGHT.descrip:
Gain 1 whenever you play a card.
At the Confusion threshold, become [gold]Confused[/gold]: your Attack damage is reduced by 20%.
At the Obstruction threshold (twice the Confusion threshold), become [gold]Obstructed[/gold]: your Attack damage is reduced by 50% and Block gained from cards is reduced by 50% ([gold]Narrate[/gold] Block is unaffected).
NYMPH_DURABILITY.title: Durability
NYMPH_DURABILITY.description: Whenever this card is played, lose 1 Durability. At 0, remove this card from your deck.
NYMPH_DISCOVERY.title: Discover
NYMPH_DISCOVERY.description: Choose 1 of 3 random cards to add to your Hand. It costs 0 this turn.
NYMPH_CARDPILE_INSPIRATION.title: Inspiration Pile
NYMPH_CARDPILE_INSPIRATION.description: Stores Inspiration cards separately. After you draw your opening hand each combat, choose 1 Inspiration from the entire pile to play immediately, or skip.
